logical.byte_bit_rule: v3 b_S=b_R=1 means Byte/element, not 1-bit arithmetic. Encoded copies add physical occupancy, never logical payload.

physical.encoding: two complementary MTJs per binary weight bit; eight pairs per signed INT8 weight
physical.physical_organization: 64 native banks x 256 rows x four IBMD columns; two banks per INT8 output
physical.update_shape: one selected row x eight aligned INT8 outputs; sixteen banks, 64 complementary pairs

neurosim_array_assignment.rule: Never substitute logical K,N for a physical array; preserve native banks, plane orientation, active rows, isolation and access direction.

physical.access_direction: W[o,i] bit b -> bank=2*o+b//4, row=i, column=b%4

native_mapping.encoding_location: local 64-bit logical data expands to 128 physical P/AP target bits before shared physical interface
native_mapping.boundary_restore: covered by read-slot initialization and final control tick
native_mapping.required_resources: 64 native 256x4 IBMD banks; 4096 active local differential digitizers and before-adder tap/mux lanes; 4096-bit new single tile register and 4096 separate AND gates; 128 write paths with 25.6 mA aggregate SL rating; 64 additional single-ended absolute-state verify lanes, 128-bit state latch, 64 comparators and 128-bit target register.
native_mapping.bank_address: W[o,i] bit b -> bank=2*o+b//4, row=i, column=b%4
native_mapping.readout_isolation: Selected local IBMD OUT nodes tapped before original bank adder; 4096 lanes select eight row groups x two output groups through 16:1 muxes. Original summed four-column bank output is not treated as independently read weights.
native_mapping.hold_lifetime: Set IN=1 to sense selected W; capture one tile for one TD; isolate/reset IBMD while separate AND gates apply all eight true input bits. Tile replacement, verification and writing are mutually exclusive.
native_mapping.bank_write_isolation: Sixteen selected banks x one row x four complementary bits; per-bank row/SL gating and unselected high-Z isolation prevent writes to other banks. Reference resource, not implicit in interface width.

resources.capacity_policy: Installed capacity is not active parallelism. No extra ADC, SA, hold bank, driver or mux lane may appear without a resource edit.

mux_scope.rule: Ratios express selected outputs/local addresses; native row/layer/CIMSEL decoding is separate. No switch capacitance or RC assumed from fanin alone.

electrical_drive_outputs.meaning: Biased/current-driven electrical outputs; not a programming target count.

program_driver_channels.meaning: Explicit independent drive channels when reported; page-engine or distributed bias outputs do not establish this count.

selected_storage_targets.meaning: Addressed storage targets per selected_batch; phase and plane organization remain explicit.

logical_bits_per_target.meaning: One binary state/pair before INT8 plane and NAND encoding expansion.

physical_cells_per_target.meaning: Complementary storage branches per addressed target.

logical_payload_per_transaction.meaning: Workload payload for an indivisible resident transaction; not bias outputs or port beats.

encoded_bits_per_load_unit.meaning: Encoded bits in one native page for NOR/NAND; otherwise one resident transaction.

data_port_width.meaning: External encoded port width; not physical program parallelism.

update_domains.meaning: One native independently scheduled update domain.

write_semantics.program_parallelism_source: selected_storage_targets plus explicitly reported channels, phases and planes; never electrical_drive_outputs or data_port_width
write_semantics.program_batch_count_rule: program_batches_per_load_unit * load_units_per_transaction; batch is a native selection/program-service target group, not an internal pulse/head count; phase/retry services remain separately scheduled.
write_semantics.phase_semantics: 64 pairs = 64 logical weight bits = 128 installed MTJ states = 8 workload Byte; phases address 128 then 64 MTJs.

phase_targets.meaning: Phase 1 addresses both MTJs of each of 64 pairs.
Phase 2 selects one MTJ of each pair.

actual_load.fanout: actual declared DAG pins; shared inputs distributed at fanout <=4; bank mux pad-to-power-of-two

source_decomposition.first_bit_source: new weight hold output at operand capture; conservatively one full MAC period even for native early capture
source_decomposition.lifecycle: input vector and group selection stable from native-read launch through all eight bit MACs; selected input combinational nodes already settled before first MAC launch
source_decomposition.weight_lifecycle: first MAC launches from completed operand capture; same weight hold persists through remaining seven bits
source_decomposition.first_capture_qualification: each early full source-to-capture delay must fit native lead plus first MAC period, checked in engine
source_decomposition.clock_dependency: native lead is a qualification check, not a per-cycle clock bound; no analog-time subtraction from MAC delay

actual_load.fanout: actual declared DAG pins; shared inputs distributed at fanout <=4; bank mux pad-to-power-of-two

module_inventory.controller_state_allocation: separate concurrent row/group/digit/page/phase/counter state; only the longest increment counter is on the controller critical path
module_inventory.input_row_group_mux_organization: Kx8 input register -> 32x8 selected combinational bytes -> 16 lane fanout; no shadow bank
module_inventory.native_page_buffers_or_native_capture: owned by retained native full service; not modeled a second time

MemCell_context.electrical_fields: zero/unused; native service fields are bound by the case adapter

coverage.digital_scope: declared gate topology and electrical load envelope; no sensitized STA or extracted wiring
coverage.verify_source_access: 128bit complementary target -> 2:1 branch mux -> 64 absolute-state comparators; native branch read provides 64 sensed bits; data and group-select fanout included; no preselected shadow register

adapter.boundary_semantics: cycle: ceil(t/P)+nP, destination setup belongs to path; capture-only: ceil((t+setup)/P), zero added cycle; included native capture is not repeated
adapter.capture_budget_revision: NOR/FeNOR tile capture and MRAM/FeNOR terminal capture: old one-tick budget replaced by exact eligible sampling edge; MRAM tile capture/isolation retains one full cycle
adapter.MAC_frame_lifecycle: input vector and row/output group already selected at native read launch; group held for all 8 bit operations; ibit and output accumulator may change each bit
adapter.downstream_ready: explicit boundary only after final physical service without existing digital consumer
adapter.retained_service_policy: opaque native cycles remain whole; only separately declared consumers use NeuroSim

inputs.scope: device.primitives plus logical, physical, resource and stage inputs in this self-contained case

schedule_policy.edge_rule: physical subsequences continuous; align at explicit digital consumer or boundary
schedule_policy.maintenance: raw request latency separated from long-term availability-adjusted service cost
